name: Chandra
description: Converts PDFs and images into Markdown, HTML or JSON with layout preserved, handling tables, forms, handwriting and 90+ languages, via a CLI with local or vLLM inference.

skills.name: Layout-Preserving OCR
skills.description: Converts images and PDFs into Markdown, HTML or JSON with detailed layout information, and extracts images and diagrams with captions.

skills.name: Tables, Forms and Math
skills.description: Reconstructs forms including checkboxes, complex tables, math and handwriting across 90+ languages from scanned or digital pages.

skills.name: Local or vLLM Inference
skills.description: Runs the model locally through HuggingFace with --method hf, or against a vLLM server launched with chandra_vllm, for single files or folders.
